evidence: The chemical bonding and film composition are investigated by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, K-alpha+, Thermo Fisher Scientific Co) and elemental mapping by Auger electron spectroscopy (AES, PHI-700, ULVAC-PHI). The surface morphologies are measured by SEM and atomic force microscopy (AFM, XE-100, Park System). X-ray diffraction (XRD, Rigaku Model SmartLab, Rigaku Corporation) was used to identify the crystallinity of the film, and X-ray reflectivity (XRR) was used to calculate the density and thickness of the film. The Ru film thickness is measured by both spectroscopic ellipsometry (UV-FMS, Ellipso Technology) and XRR measurements.
